short_description: See your Claude Code sessions at a glance and answer permission prompts with the bar's buttons.
description:
Shows every Claude Code session running on your computer: which ones are working, which are done and waiting for you, and how long each task has taken. When Claude asks for permission to run a command, the bar blinks amber and you answer Yes or No with the wheel and Start, without switching windows.

## What you need

The app shows what a small companion on your computer sends it; the bar never talks to the internet. Install the companion with one command from the [app's repository](https://github.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code): it adds a Claude Code plugin, puts this app on the bar over USB and pairs the two with a random token. Works on macOS and Windows. Only sessions on that computer show up; cloud sessions do not.

## Controls

- **Wheel**: moves through the sessions; on a permission prompt, picks Yes or No.
- **Start** or **wheel press**: opens a session; on a prompt, sends the answer.
- **Back**: returns to the list; on a prompt, hands it back to the terminal; from the list, closes the app.

## Settings

Setup fills in the computer's address and the token. If the bar says "Wrong token", or you move to a new computer, see the [FAQ](https://github.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code#faq). **Context bar** draws how full the session's context window is along the bottom edge of the screen.
